links.outcome: Adenoma detection rate with AI-assisted versus conventional colonoscopy
links.effect: ADR was 60% in the AI group versus 50% in controls, not statistically significant (p>0.05); withdrawal time 29 vs 27 min, no significant difference.
links.quote: ADR was higher in the AI group (60%) than in the control group (50%), but this difference was not statistically significant (p>0.05).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic performance and adenoma detection rates of real-time AI-assisted colonoscopy compared to conventional colonoscopy in actual patients, but it tests the AI tool itself rather than a deployment safeguard or implementation practice.
